items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: And I used to play with Earl Foster too. We used to play at Skinner's place out in Buccalus.

ctx.x: That was tough. Stop on the road and eat watermelon. Anything you could see to eat. Corn, anything. Sugar cane, anything. That's true. Old bus break down and we walk. And I used to play with Earl Foster too. We used to play at Skinner's place out in Buccalus. Oh he had a Cadillac with crepe-de-sheen ties. Now he had to be there at work for nine o'clock and leave here at eight o'clock. Now he'd go across the bridge, you know how he lived? Like the tunnel over in the lake, the tie busted and all of them. Right on…
So I told him, I said. Were those open cars or something those days, or what were they like?
